page_title: ESP 0-2 SEV | Espanyol v Sevilla 25/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' That's it for today, Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+12' Sevilla take a short corner kick.

90+12' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! The ball goes out of play. Sevilla are awarded a corner kick.
90+11' A quickly taken corner by Espanyol.
90+10' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to make a change. Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) replaces Dodi Lukebakio.
90+10' That will be all from Isaac Romero who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jesus Navas (Sevilla).
90+8' Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) gets to the rebound but blows his chance to score with a header from a dangerous position inside the box. His effort floats high over the bar.
90+7' Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
90+7' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Espanyol will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+3' The ball has crossed the sideline. Espanyol are taking a throw-in.
90+1' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias shows a yellow card to Pol Lozano (Espanyol) for a tough tackle.
90' The fourth official shows 11 min. of added time.
89' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
88' Pere Milla (Espanyol) meets a cross inside the box, but Orjan Nyland wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
84' Irvin Cardona (Espanyol) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
82' Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
81' Here is a change. Juanlu Sanchez is going off and Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta gives the last tactical orders to Djibril Sow (Sevilla).
81' Here's the change. Javi Puado leaves the pitch and Irvin Cardona (Espanyol) comes on as a substitute.
81' The Espanyol players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias. NO PENALTY!
79' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Espanyol, he's going to review using VAR.
79' Handball! A player from Sevilla handled the ball. Espanyol have been awarded a penalty kick!
78' Espanyol failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
77' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Javi Puado (Espanyol) inside the box. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Espanyol.
76' Espanyol force a corner. They send men into the box.
76' The ball is cleared after Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
73' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
71' Alejo Veliz (Espanyol) rises above the defence to meet the corner. His timing is good, but he arrows his header just a few inches wide of the right post.
71' Espanyol win a corner.
68' Substitution. Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Omar El Hilali walks off.
68' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to substitute Jofre and he is replaced by Pere Milla (Espanyol).
66' Sevilla are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence.
63' Alvaro Fernandez (Sevilla) comes onto the pitch because Orjan Nyland simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
63' Substitution. Valentin Barco (Sevilla) on for Stanis Idumbo.
61' The game is interrupted now, Orjan Nyland (Sevilla) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
60' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Espanyol.
59' Referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias sees the trip by Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Espanyol win a free kick.
59' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Espanyol comes to nothing.
58' The referee allows time for a substitution. Walid Cheddira will be replaced by Alejo Veliz (Espanyol).
58' Manolo Gonzalez decides to make a substitution. Brian Olivan will be replaced by Carlos Romero (Espanyol).
58' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
57' A player from Espanyol commits a rough challenge. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
56' The ball goes out of play. Espanyol are awarded a corner kick.
56' Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
54' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
52' Orjan Nyland (Sevilla) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
51' Espanyol have a corner.
51' The attendance is 23656.
49' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
48' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
47' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' 0 - 2 Goal! Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner.
45' Brian Olivan (Espanyol) receives a cross on the edge of the box. He doesn't hesitate and fires a bullet towards the goal. Nevertheless, the goalkeeper had no trouble dealing with his shot.
44' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) sends a cross into the box, but Joan Garcia comes off his line to gather the ball.
42' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
39' The corner is swung in but Espanyol can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
39' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Walid Cheddira (Espanyol) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
36' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Sevilla, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
34' The statistic for corner kicks – 3:1.
30' Marash Kumbulla (Espanyol) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
28' The linesman signals a throw-in for Sevilla.
27' Sevilla can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
26' Stanis Idumbo (Sevilla) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Sevilla win a corner kick.
24' The corner is swung in and Walid Cheddira (Espanyol) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker wide of the right post from close in.
23' Espanyol have been awarded a corner kick.
20' 0 - 1 Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) scores an absolute screamer from outside the penalty area, with the ball flying into the top left corner!
16' Espanyol are ruled offside.
14' One of the players from Espanyol times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
12' Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) produces a good shot from the resulting free kick. His effort, however, goes just wide of the left post.
12' Espanyol are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
11' A cross into the box from Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) is cleared.
10' Espanyol take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
10' Jofre (Espanyol) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
8' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Sevilla, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
7' A player from Espanyol takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
5' Sevilla are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
3' Espanyol have been awarded a corner kick.
2' Walid Cheddira (Espanyol) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
1' Jofre (Espanyol) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
1' The match has just started.
Espanyol will kick-off.
Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias is the one to supervise the game today.
